$comment-1: QuantConnect LEAN project config for v1_trend_following.
$comment-2: POST-PIVOT 2026-05-12 (Pivot-PR-A): canonical deploy path is LEAN Local in a Dockerized container on the operator's VPS. The pre-pivot 'QC Cloud' path is RETIRED — QC's /object/get is gated behind the Institutional subscription tier (DP-025), so the QC-Cloud-mediated Phase 1 architecture is no longer feasible.
$comment-3: Post-pivot deploy: docker compose up -d lean_local. The container's entrypoint resolves sops bundle → env vars (LEAN_LOCAL_BEARER_TOKEN, LEAN_IBKR_USERNAME/PASSWORD) then launches LEAN Launcher against this config.
$comment-4: Brokerage: InteractiveBrokersBrokerage (live-mode) via the ib_gateway sidecar container (Pivot-PR-B). Backtest mode uses QC's BacktestingTransactionHandler with simulated IBKR fees per the brokerage MODEL.
$comment-5: Strategy logic in strategies/v1_trend_following/ is broker-agnostic and runs identically under any of these environments.
$comment-algorithm-location: LEAN Local reads this field — the file was renamed from v1_qc_algorithm.py to v1_strategy.py post-pivot (Pivot-PR-A Q3 resolution). The QC Cloud deploy path is retired so the dual-filename pattern from the pre-pivot README is no longer needed.
description: v1_trend_following — Donchian/MA/Hurst/ATR trend strategy on Phase 1 sub-universe (CME micro futures + bond ETFs). Daily resolution, 17:30 ET signal cycle. Runs locally via LEAN Local + direct IBKR (Pivot-PR-A post-pivot).
$comment-parameters: Mirrors strategies/v1_trend_following/parameters.py V1_DEFAULTS. The algorithm reads them via self.get_parameter(...) with V1_DEFAULTS as fallback. Keys are the canonical agent `tighten_parameter` enum names (backend-spec §12.3) — never rename without a parameter_sets migration.

environments.$comment: LEAN Local environments. The `lean_local` Docker container's entrypoint renders this section by env-var substitution before launching the LEAN runtime. Production env is selected via `LEAN_LIVE_MODE=true` + `ENVIRONMENT=paper|live-small|live-scale`.

backtesting.$comment: Backtest against QC bundled historical bars. Used in CI golden tests + ad-hoc parameter sweeps. No broker dependency.

paper-ibkr.$comment: Paper trading against IBKR's paper account via ib_gateway container (Pivot-PR-B). Use this for the 30-CME-session paper clock before live cutover.

live-ibkr.$comment: Live trading against IBKR's real account via ib_gateway container (Pivot-PR-B). Production env after Week 8 live cutover.
